text: This report provides an annual update of the Investment Manager fees paid by the Toronto Investment Board for the year ending December 31, 2021. The confidential attachment to this report provides a summary of the fees.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 11, 2022) from the Director, Capital Markets remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to the security of property belonging to the City and the Toronto Investment Board.
